title: Исход 25 — Exodus 25
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: Вели им сделать мне ___, и я буду обитать среди них.
cases.translation: Have them make me a sanctuary, and I will dwell among them.
cases.explain: Святилище is the direct object of сделать (to make); for a neuter noun the accusative equals the nominative → святилище.

cases.translation: Have them make an ark of acacia wood.
cases.explain: Ковчег is the direct object of сделать; for an inanimate masculine noun the accusative equals the nominative → ковчег.

cases.sentence: Сделай из ___ шесты и позолоти их.
cases.translation: Make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of / made from) takes the genitive → акации.

cases.sentence: Покрой его чистым ___ внутри и снаружи.
cases.translation: Overlay it with pure gold inside and out.
cases.explain: The verb покрыть (to cover/overlay) takes the instrumental for the material used → золотом.

cases.sentence: Вложи шесты в кольца на обеих сторонах ___.
cases.translation: Put the poles into the rings on both sides of the ark.
cases.explain: Possession ("the sides of the ark") is expressed by the genitive → ковчега.

cases.sentence: …над крышкой искупления, между ___, над ковчегом свидетельства.
cases.translation: …above the mercy seat, between the cherubim, over the ark of the covenant.
cases.explain: The preposition между (between) takes the instrumental → херувимами (instrumental plural).

cases.sentence: Сделай всё точно по ___, который был тебе показан на горе.
cases.translation: Make everything exactly according to the pattern shown to you on the mountain.
cases.explain: The preposition по meaning "according to" takes the dative → образцу.

cases.sentence: …по образцу, который был тебе показан на ___.
cases.translation: …according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.
cases.explain: The preposition на meaning "on/at" a location (no motion) takes the prepositional → горе.

reading.ru: Вели им сделать мне святилище, и я буду обитать среди них.
reading.question: Why does God want the Israelites to make a sanctuary?
options: So that he may dwell among them
So that they can store their gold
So that they can hold markets
So that they can bury their dead
reading.correct: So that he may dwell among them
reading.explain: God asks for a sanctuary so that he may dwell among the people.

reading.ru: Покрой его чистым золотом внутри и снаружи, и сделай вокруг него золотой ободок.
reading.question: How was the ark to be overlaid?
options: With pure gold, inside and out
With bronze on the outside only
reading.correct: With pure gold, inside and out
reading.explain: The ark was to be overlaid with pure gold both inside and outside, with a gold molding around it.

reading.ru: Пусть шесты остаются в кольцах ковчега, их нельзя вынимать.
reading.question: What instruction is given about the poles of the ark?
options: They must stay in the rings and not be removed
They must be gilded each year
They must be burned after use
They must be replaced with bronze ones
reading.correct: They must stay in the rings and not be removed
reading.explain: The poles were to remain in the rings of the ark and were not to be taken out.

reading.ru: Пусть херувимы простирают крылья вверх, закрывая ими крышку искупления.
reading.question: What are the cherubim to do with their wings?
options: Spread them upward, covering the mercy seat
reading.correct: Spread them upward, covering the mercy seat
reading.explain: The cherubim were to spread their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with them.

reading.ru: Всегда клади передо мной на этот стол хлеб присутствия.
reading.question: What was to be placed on the table before God at all times?
reading.explain: The bread of the presence was to be set on the table before God continually.

reading.ru: Сделай светильник из чистого золота, пусть его основание и ножка будут кованые работы, а чашечки, бутоны и лепестки составляют с ним одно целое.
reading.question: What was the lampstand to be made of?
reading.explain: The lampstand, including its base and shaft, was to be made of hammered pure gold.
